about.metaDescription: About the developer behind the work and the journal.
about.title: A developer who cares about the space between function and feeling.
about.lead: I build web experiences that are useful, inclusive, and enjoyable to spend time with.
about.paragraph1: I enjoy working across design and engineering: shaping an idea, finding the simplest system behind it, and carrying the details all the way into production.
about.paragraph2: When I'm not at my desk, I'm usually walking through a new city, looking for good food, or writing down the small moments I don't want to forget.

pdfToolPage.metaDescription: Compare progress metrics from multiple SE2026 PDF reports in your browser.
pdfToolPage.title: See the numbers move.
pdfToolPage.description: Compare PML supervisors, PCL field workers, or the whole report across multiple progress PDFs—without sending the files anywhere.

pdfTool.uploadDescription: Select two or more reports to see how a person's numbers change between report dates.
pdfTool.localNote: Files stay in this browser and are never uploaded or saved.
pdfTool.errorsTitle: Some files could not be read.
pdfTool.chartAria: over time. Focus or point at a data point for details.
pdfTool.missingDays: day(s) could not be interpolated because there is no actual value on both sides.
pdfTool.forecastPrompt: Choose a future forecast date to calculate the pace needed to reach this target.
pdfTool.insufficientForecast: At least two actual values are needed to compare a forecast with the target.
pdfTool.forecastDisclaimer: Linear estimate based on all actual report values. This is not a guarantee.
pdfTool.behindAction: To reach the target, average {required} per day from the latest actual report—{additional} more per day than the current forecasted trend.
pdfTool.aheadAction: At the current forecasted trend, the target should be exceeded by {difference}. The minimum pace needed from the latest actual report is {required} per day.
pdfTool.metAction: The current forecast is aligned with the target. Maintain approximately {required} per day from the latest actual report.
pdfTool.waitingDescription: The chart will appear here after you select PDF files.
pdfTool.supportedMetrics: Missing days are linearly interpolated only when actual values exist on both sides. Choose a future date to extend a linear regression based on all uploaded reports.
pdfTool.jmlSubmitNote: The default Jml Submit (Real) maps to Real in the older report format.
pdfTool.unsupportedReport: This PDF is not a supported SE2026 progress report.
pdfTool.dateNotFound: The report date could not be found.
pdfTool.monthNotRecognized: The report month is not recognized.
pdfTool.pmlRowsMissing: No supervisor (PML) rows could be read.
pdfTool.pclRowsMissing: No field worker (PCL) rows could be read.
pdfTool.pclRowsPartial: Read {count} PCL rows; the report may contain more.
pdfTool.toolDescription: Compare progress metrics from multiple SE2026 reports locally.
